proposal.rationale: All five peers report readiness 'known', so none are unresolved. peer-02 only advertises kem:x25519 and cannot satisfy any PQC-capable profile's required capability, so it is left on the current profile for now. peer-01, peer-03, peer-04, and peer-05 all advertise kem:x25519mlkem768 and kem:mlkem768, making them ready for either tls13-hybrid-x25519-mlkem768 (hybrid-pqc) or tls13-mlkem768 (pqc) \u2014 both profiles tie at 4 ready endpoints, the maximum achievable in this batch. Per the task rule, ties should prefer the higher security class (pqc), but peer-01's notes cite an explicit CAB decision (2026-31) that pure ML-KEM profiles are not yet cleared for production and directs use of the hybrid profile for this migration. Treating that as a binding organizational constraint, tls13-mlkem768 is not viable at this time, so tls13-hybrid-x25519-mlkem768 (hybrid-pqc, at/above the hybrid-pqc security floor) is proposed instead, still achieving the maximum of 4 ready endpoints. The asset has liboqs-0.16.0 present, satisfying the implementation requirement. Change should occur in the Tuesday 02:00-04:00 UTC window with handshake error-rate monitoring for 30 minutes per the rollback/change-window note, with results recorded in the ticket.
